method: 1:1 visual measurement of duplicated drafted ground
measurement_notes: Corner coordinates from sub-pixel intersection of ink-centroid total-least-squares line fits on the two edges meeting at each corner (edge-fit rms 0.1-1.7 px); every point verified on-vertex with 2.5-4x crosshair crops in BOTH panels. Color washes are misregistered relative to linework throughout; only black linework was measured. Template matching (NCC) was used to propose candidates but never accepted without visual verification - repeated linework produced multiple false peaks.

divider_rule.description: Full-height triple rule (thin-thick-thin, thick band ~22-25 px wide) separating the panels; centerline of the thick rule measured at 710 rows (robust sigma-clipped fit).
divider_rule.thick_centerline_quadratic: x = 3788.24 + 0.017298*y - 9.265e-7*y^2  (rms 1.36 px; rule is measurably bowed)
divider_rule.task_formula_check: x = 3789 + 0.0099*y tracks the WEST EDGE of the thick rule (centerline minus half-width ~11 px), not its centerline; consistent within ~3-8 px over the full height.

panel_bounds_in_overlap_band.panel_A_bottom_strip: x ~1990 (Pier 22 deck W edge; bay wash to ~1400) to ~3790 (content; divider W edge ~3862 at y 7400), y ~6925 (ground equal to panel B page top) to ~7660 (linework ends; paper continues to 7795)
panel_bounds_in_overlap_band.panel_B_top_strip: x ~4100 (bay wash; linework from ~4660) to ~6500 (content; page edge 6653), y ~25 (below scanner border; linework from ~55) to ~860 (ground equal to panel A bottom content edge)
panel_bounds_in_overlap_band.usable_overlap_ground: Roughly 670 px along the frontage (A y 6990-7660 == B y 50-720) by ~1700 px perpendicular. Ground north of A y~6960 is cut off by panel B's page top; ground south of A y~7660 is cut off by panel A's page bottom.

correspondences.feature: Bay-side (NW) bottom corner of the Pier 22 'GALVESTON WHARF CO'S SHED / GULF FISHERY CO LESSEE' shed inner outline (corner of shed left wall and shed bottom wall)
correspondences.verification: Same tilted shed on Pier 22, 'PIER 22' label adjacent in both panels; inner-outline bottom-edge length matches (A 242 px, B 233 px); nested inside matching heavy deck outline. Note B's copy is cut by the page top so only the bottom portion exists.

correspondences.feature: Slip-side (SE) bottom corner of the Gulf Fishery shed inner outline
correspondences.verification: Opposite end of the same shed bottom edge as xp1; corner formed with shed right wall sloping up-left in both panels; slip wash to the east in both.

correspondences.feature: SW corner of the Pier 22 deck outline (outer heavy line around the shed), bayward end of the deck's south face
correspondences.verification: Heavy outer polygon concentric with shed in both panels, water wash outside; strongest NCC match of all features (0.87, second peak 0.52) plus on-vertex visual check.

correspondences.feature: SE corner of the Pier 22 deck outline (outer heavy line), where deck south face meets deck east (slip) face
correspondences.verification: Same outer polygon as xp3; deck east face runs up along the slip in both panels; corner slightly rounded, fitted as intersection of the two edge lines.

correspondences.feature: Intersection of the 10-inch W.PIPE dashed line (running N-S, labeled in panel A) with the 22nd St double-dashed street line
correspondences.verification: Both panels draw both dashed lines crossing at right angles west of the track fan; '22ND ST' label adjacent in both. Intersection of two fitted lines, immune to dash phase.

correspondences.feature: NW corner of the block 9 corner building at the SE corner of Ave A x 22nd St intersection (building front on Ave A east side, south of 22nd St)
correspondences.verification: Same corner motif (top edge running east, wall running south) at the same street-grid position in both panels; A's Ave A frontage walls align (3674/3686) confirming careful drafting on the A side; B side is B's main territory. Confidence med only because the point lies in panel A's margin strip south of 22nd St.

correspondences.feature: NW corner of the warehouse south of 22nd St between the track fan and Ave A: its north edge (drawn solid+dashed in A, solid in B) meets the heavy west wall descending south
correspondences.verification: Same motif in both panels: north edge approaching from the west, heavy wall turning south at the corner. Identity confirmed by spacing to xp6 (A 218.7 px, B 221.3 px - equal within 3 px) even though A renders part of the north edge dashed. An earlier candidate pairing (A bar-x-track junction at (3402.6,7326.5)) was caught and discarded during verification - the descending line there is a yard track crossing the bar, not the wall.

rejected.feature: T.H. dot (watchman station) on the wharf east of the slip, panel A (2791,7150)
rejected.reason: Not drawn in panel B at the corresponding location (verified blank paper at 1:1); symbol exists in one draft only.

rejected.feature: West and east termini of the 22nd St double-dash line
rejected.reason: Dash-run endpoints are draftsman's whim, not physical: east ends differ by >100 px between panels (A ends ~x3760, B ends ~x6303 east of Ave A) after accounting for offset.

rejected.feature: SW corner of block 9 building NORTH of 22nd St at Ave A (A (3675,7085))
rejected.reason: Panel B's copy is a displaced margin simplification: B draws that building front at x6281 while B's own south-of-22nd front is at 6332 (51 px misaligned), whereas panel A aligns them (3674/3686). B-side placement untrustworthy at the 40-50 px level.

rejected.feature: Track switch frogs / diamond crossing in the terminal-track yard (e.g. B crossing at (5648,208))
rejected.reason: Yard trackage is drawn with different simplification in each panel's margin strip (A shows 2 tracks where B shows 3 with a crossing; A ~6 lines vs B ~16 south of 22nd St); individual track identity cannot be established reliably.

rejected.feature: South tips of drawn track lines at panel A's bottom edge (y ~7640-7660)
rejected.reason: Clipped by the page/content edge, not physical track ends.

rejected.feature: Shed top ('IRON CLAD') corners and slip-head bulkhead chamfer corners (A (2650,6845),(2685,6920))
rejected.reason: Corresponding ground lies above panel B's page top (B y < 25); drawn only in panel A.

rejected.feature: Slip east bulkhead line as a point feature
rejected.reason: Straight line with no crossing feature inside the overlap; nearly vertical so it constrains only x. Note: its offset (dx ~2653) also disagrees with the shed group (dx ~2681) - the two drafts disagree on slip width by ~30 px (~11 ft).

rejected.feature: West end of the xp7 warehouse north edge (A (3355,7325) / B (6040,367))
rejected.reason: Drawn differently relative to the adjacent slanted yard track: in A the edge tip floats ~10 px east of the track, in B it abuts the track exactly; the track positions themselves differ between drafts, so the tip is not a stable physical point.

rejected.feature: Large '5' numerals in both panels; dot inside shed near SE corner; yellow diagonal deck hatches
rejected.reason: '5' is the sheet/panel label (arbitrary placement); shed dot present in A only; yellow hatches are wash, misregistered relative to linework.

similarity_fit_A_to_B.consistency_flag: The correspondences do NOT support a single similarity at measurement precision. The global weighted fit leaves 2-23 px residuals against 3-6 px localization sigmas (chi excess ~2-4x on xp4, xp5), and the fitted parameters are unstable across subsets: shed group alone gives scale 1.020 / rot +0.49 deg, east group alone 1.024 / +0.96 deg, global 0.981 / -0.55 deg. Structure of the disagreement: each group is internally consistent (east group xp5-7 fits to 1.3 px rms; shed group to 7 px) but the groups are mutually displaced ~25 px in x - independently confirmed by the slip east bulkhead and 10-inch pipe lines, which sit ~2652 px east of their panel-A twins while the shed corners sit ~2681 px east. The two hand drafts disagree on the slip/yard width by ~25-30 px (~10-11 ft at 100 ft/inch). Additionally each panel simplifies and locally displaces detail in its marginal (non-primary) strip by up to ~50 px (see rejected list). Recommendation: treat cross-panel registration on sheet 5 as good to ~10-25 px only, or solve with a low-order warp / per-group weighting rather than a rigid similarity.
